name: 21-money-projects-escalation
description: Reported spending first holds a task, then pauses its project. The owner raises the limits, moves a task through a paused project, and sees rework with and without a stronger builder.
covers: Milestone 5 AT-1 and PRD Cost: task cap, project budget, two held tasks, claim eligibility, and a job result charged to the project.
PRD Projects and holds, AP-11 and AP-12: a budget raise resumes a budget-paused project, manual resume still leaves the budget in claim eligibility, and moving a task changes its project hold.
PRD Rework and escalation, AP-24 and AP-25: the second failure requires a stronger seat when available and otherwise returns to the same seat.

commands.note: The report reaches the task cap while the project still has room.
The second report reaches the project budget while the task stays below its cap.
The new budget is above reported spending. Both project holds close.

body.text: Should the ledger use whole units?

commands.note: The job reaches the project budget. Its spending leaves the task cap alone.

result.answer: Use whole units as stated in the project brief.

commands.note: The owner lifts the holds. The project is still at its budget.
The available builder cannot claim the ready appendix even though the holds are gone.
The ledger has spent eleven dollars against its own cap. The job cost would have made this report hold it.
No enabled builder has rank three. The second failure returns the appendix to its rank-two builder.
